summary: Endpoint diagnostics stay on the joints they describe after edits. Endpoint cluster ids are positional and are renumbered whenever an edit re-clusters endpoints, and a split start replaces segments with new pieces, so snap, ambiguity, branching, open-chain and gap diagnostics could keep stale segment or cluster references, or a reused id could silently describe a different joint. After each edit, these diagnostics are now rebuilt from the current topology. An id is kept only when every surviving endpoint agrees on one successor joint; otherwise the diagnostic gets a fresh id, and every chain, contour, path element and plan reference to a retired id is removed. Diagnostics are recognized by code and ownership rather than by id prefix, so saved diagnostics with any id are preserved.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output. Diagnostic ids and references can change after an edit, where they previously went stale: a diagnostic whose joint changed gets a new diag_endpoint_refresh_ id, and an analysis diagnostic whose generated id collides with a saved diagnostic gets a __refresh_ suffix. Diagnostic codes, severities and blocking are unchanged.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage or journal schema change. Post engine API remains 1; saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, WebMCP tool, cancellation or input-version behavior change.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding or controller-file change. Planning, compensation and posting read the same diagnostic codes; only their ids and references after an edit are corrected.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents are not rewritten until edited.
checklist.verification: Fifteen new path-editor tests cover a split start that renumbers clusters, a bow-tie branching junction split, successor disagreement between nearby joints, saved diagnostics with arbitrary or misleading id prefixes, repeated reversals with plan copies, and a resolved warning whose id must not be reused; the original cases fail on the previous code. The pure-domain suite (1,395 tests), the path-editor, UPID and storage suites (815 tests), tsc -b and npm run lint pass.

testedPosts.scope: Posting code is untouched; Robofil 2.6.0 package and current-contract tests pass unchanged. No physical-machine verification.

publicNotes.summary: Geometry warnings stay attached to the right joints after edits.
changes: After splitting, reversing or moving a start, endpoint warnings point at the current segments and joints instead of stale or reused ones.
publicNotes.compatibility: Posted programs, installed posts and saved projects are unchanged.
